biocs.name: Process Reading Bash History
biocs.description: Process accessing .bash_history file for credential harvesting
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE_ACCESS
| filter action_file_path = '/home/www-data/.bash_history'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'bash'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'sh'
